descriptions.Total Length of Fwd Packets: Cumulative payload length of all forward packets in the flow
descriptions.Bwd Packet Length Max: Maximum backward packet length observed in the flow
descriptions.Flow Bytes/s: Total flow volume in bytes divided by flow duration
descriptions.Fwd IAT Total: Total elapsed time between successive forward packets
descriptions.Bwd IAT Total: Total elapsed time between successive backward packets
descriptions.Fwd PSH Flags: Number of times the PSH flag was set in forward packets
descriptions.Fwd Packets/s: Number of forward packets per second
descriptions.FIN Flag Count: Number of packets with the FIN flag set
descriptions.Fwd Avg Bytes/Bulk: Average bytes transferred per forward bulk transmission
descriptions.Bwd Avg Bulk Rate: Rate of bytes transmitted per backward bulk transmission
descriptions.Subflow Fwd Packets: Average number of packets per forward subflow
descriptions.Init_Win_bytes_forward: Initial TCP window size advertised in forward direction
descriptions.Active Mean: Mean duration the flow was active before going idle
descriptions.Idle Mean: Mean duration the flow was idle between active periods

score_meaning: Random Forest probability; not a calibrated guarantee for production use.
